meta.title: Swing Low Sweet Chariot Efp
meta.subtitle: MidKar old blues page · 4/4 · MidKar · Blues MIDI (old page)

lyrics:
Heck why not?  This tune was on old 75 vinyl I cam across.  Have no idea on the artist but do like the feel.  I did take some liberties on this one.

Doc Doc

Special Note: The sound module used is a Roland SC-33 (SC-55).  The midi file uses Controllers 32, 101, 100, 6, Chorus, Reverb, Bends and SysEx.  Some low end sound cards do not recognize these parameters. Hence the bends and mods will sound funky.
